action:
# Open the “File” menu in LibreOffice Impress to access Save As option
pyautogui.click(x=50, y=50, duration=0.5)

# Click the "File" menu in LibreOffice Impress’s menu bar to open file options
pyautogui.click(x=85, y=54, duration=0.5)

# Switch back to the previously open LibreOffice Impress window with Alt+Tab
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'tab')

# Click the “File” option in the top-left menu bar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=50, y=52, duration=0.5)

# Switch back from Chrome to the LibreOffice Impress window using Alt+Tab
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'tab')

# Click the “File” menu label in LibreOffice Impress’s top menu bar (to open its dropdown options)
pyautogui.click(x=110, y=52, duration=0.5)

# Open the “Save As” dialog with Ctrl+Shift+S shortcut
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 's')

# Click the “Desktop” location in the save dialog’s left sidebar to set destination folder
pyautogui.click(x=318, y=133, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” folder in the save dialog’s left sidebar to change the save location to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=320, y=150, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” location in the left sidebar (just below “Home”) to set save destination to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=318, y=120, duration=0.5)

# Select the “Desktop” folder in the left sidebar of the save dialog to change destination
pyautogui.click(x=318, y=140, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” folder in the save dialog’s left sidebar (second item under Home) to set it as destination
pyautogui.click(x=330, y=130, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” option in the left sidebar of the save dialog to change the destination folder
pyautogui.click(x=309, y=125, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” folder in the left sidebar (just below “Home”) to set save location
pyautogui.click(x=315, y=107, duration=0.5)

# Replace current filename in the Name field with “pre.pptx” to set the desired file name
pyautogui.typewrite('pre.pptx')

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second row in the left sidebar) so it becomes the selected save location
pyautogui.click(x=340, y=132, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” folder in the left sidebar (second item, just below “Home”) so it becomes the selected destination
pyautogui.click(x=320, y=118, duration=0.5)

# Double-click the “Desktop” entry in the save dialog’s left sidebar to set destination to Desktop
pyautogui.doubleClick(x=330, y=122, duration=0.25)

# Click the “Desktop” entry in the left sidebar (second row below Home) to switch destination to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=319, y=145, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” item in the save dialog’s left sidebar (second entry, just beneath “Home”) to set Desktop as the save location
pyautogui.click(x=300, y=120, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Desktop" entry in the left sidebar (second item) to set Desktop as the save destination
pyautogui.click(x=340, y=127, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry in the save dialog’s left sidebar (second item under Home) to set Desktop as the destination
pyautogui.click(x=240, y=150, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” item (second row in left sidebar) to set Desktop as the save destination
pyautogui.click(x=330, y=115, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” item in the save dialog’s left sidebar to change destination to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=312, y=138, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” option in the left sidebar (second item) so it becomes the selected destination
pyautogui.click(x=312, y=144, duration=0.5)

# Double-click the “Desktop” entry (second item in left sidebar) to select Desktop as save location
pyautogui.doubleClick(x=320, y=128, duration=0.3)

# Click the “Desktop” item (second row in left sidebar) to select Desktop as the save destination
pyautogui.click(x=305, y=155, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (monitor icon, second row in left sidebar) to set Desktop as the save destination
pyautogui.click(x=345, y=118, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second row under Home in left sidebar) to set the save location to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=318, y=160, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Desktop" entry (monitor icon row under Home) in the left sidebar to set Desktop as the save location
pyautogui.click(x=350, y=112, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second row in sidebar, roughly centre of its width) to set Desktop as save location
pyautogui.click(x=380, y=118, duration=0.5)

# Press the Up arrow key twice to move selection from “Downloads” up to “Desktop” in the sidebar
pyautogui.press('up', presses=2, interval=0.1)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second item below Home) in the save dialog’s sidebar to change destination
pyautogui.click(x=306, y=140, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Documents” entry (immediately above the highlighted “Downloads”) in the sidebar to verify sidebar selection changes
pyautogui.click(x=318, y=146, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second row in the sidebar under Home) to set Desktop as the save destination
pyautogui.click(x=330, y=137, duration=0.5)

# Click near the left side of the “Desktop” row (monitor icon) in sidebar to select Desktop as save destination
pyautogui.click(x=260, y=120, duration=0.5)

# Click the "user" breadcrumb in the path bar (left of “Downloads”) to open the home directory
pyautogui.click(x=440, y=103, duration=0.5)

# Reopen “Save As” dialog in LibreOffice Impress with Ctrl+Shift+S
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 's')

# Select the "Desktop" entry (second row beneath Home) in the sidebar to set Desktop as save destination
pyautogui.click(x=315, y=140, duration=0.5)

# Click the “user” breadcrumb in the path bar to open Home directory in the file chooser
pyautogui.click(x=430, y=103, duration=0.5)

# Open the “Save As” dialog in LibreOffice Impress using the shortcut
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 's')

# Click the “Home” entry at the top of the left sidebar to open the home directory
pyautogui.click(x=309, y=103, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (second item with monitor icon) in the left sidebar to set Desktop as save location
pyautogui.click(x=320, y=115, duration=0.5)

# Click the “Desktop” entry (monitor icon, second item under Home in left sidebar) within the sidebar area to set Desktop as the save location
pyautogui.click(x=200, y=146, duration=0.5)

# Focus the location entry field in the Save dialog to allow typing a path
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')

# Type '~/Desktop' followed by Enter in the location field to change the save destination to the Desktop folder
pyautogui.typewrite('~/Desktop\n')

# Type the desired filename “pre.pptx” into the focused Name field
pyautogui.typewrite('pre.pptx')

# Click the green “Save” button in the top-right of the dialog to confirm saving pre.pptx to Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=1095, y=72, duration=0.5)

# Click the green “Save” button (top-right of dialog) to save file as pre.pptx on Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=1098, y=72, duration=0.3)

# Click the green “Save” button (top-right of the Save As dialog) to save pre.pptx on Desktop
pyautogui.click(x=1115, y=72, duration=0.2)
